name: Harbin-re
description: Harbin-re was a planet located in the Harbin-re system of the Inner Rim. It was famous for productions of operas from the Neoclassical period, including several compositions favored by the Galactic Emperor Palpatine. On the date 35:10:16, the Harbin-re opera was mentioned in an Imperial HoloVision news report.
